items.headline: SEBI price‑band rule lifts foreign ETF prices above NAV
items.hook: Investors face premium risk as SEBI’s new price‑band lifts ETF prices
gist: SEBI introduced a price‑band rule for foreign ETFs.
Rule pushed ETF market prices above their NAVs.
Investors risk losses if the artificial premium collapses.

items.headline: Mutual fund investments remain protected when asset management firms shut down
items.hook: Underlying securities and investor units survive an asset management company closure intact.
gist: Fund house closures do not wipe out underlying mutual fund unit holdings.
Trustees and custodians hold securities separately from the fund management business.
Watch regulatory approvals for scheme transfers or liquidation timelines during windups.

items.hook: Indian solar exporters face over 120% tariffs on US shipments
gist: US levies over 120% duties on Indian solar cell imports.
Indian exporters confront higher costs and possible sales decline.
Watch for export volumes and domestic pricing adjustments.

gist: RBI denied Tata Sons' request to surrender NBFC status

Watch for Tata Sons' IPO timeline

The rollout of the digital platform and integration with the e-Shram database.

gist: India reported 7.8% GDP growth, prompting dispute.

gist: SEBI launched a Demat 2.0 pilot to tokenise corporate bonds.
It automates interest payments and enables instant settlement for bond investors.
Watch the expansion of this pilot to more issuers and secondary market trading.

The adoption rate of local currency settlement systems in bilateral trade agreements.

gist: Indian benchmark indices fell for the fifth consecutive week amid global pressures.

Watch if cooling oil prices trigger a short-term rebound from oversold levels.
